name: oneloom
description: Fast local screen recorder for Windows that saves straight into your OneDrive.
author: OneLoom

scripts.dev: npm run assets && node scripts/run-local.mjs electron-vite dev
scripts.start: npm run assets && node scripts/run-local.mjs electron-vite preview
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run assets && electron-vite build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run assets && electron-vite build && node scripts/run-local.mjs playwright test
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/run-local.mjs electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never && node scripts/zip-release.mjs
scripts.dist:installer: npm run build && node scripts/run-local.mjs electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
